text:
Phosphocreatine resynthesis after very high intensity exercise is fast but not instantaneous: most (about 70–85%) is restored within 30–60 seconds, and near-complete restoration typically takes about 3–5 minutes, with full recovery up to ~5–8 minutes depending on the individual and prior exercise. The claim that it is restored within seconds is incorrect, since resynthesis is oxygen-dependent and rate-limited by creatine kinase and oxidative ATP supply rather than being an immediate chemical reversal.

CONFIDENCE: 90
